questions.question: What counts as a funding-rate spike?
questions.recommended: An 8-hour funding rate above its 30-day 95th percentile.

questions.question: Which universe and timeframe?
questions.recommended: BTC perpetual futures on one major venue, hourly bars.

questions.question: What is the entry and exit?
questions.recommended: Enter against the crowded side at the next hourly open after a spike; exit after 24 hours.

questions.question: What kills the idea?
questions.recommended: A net Sharpe below 0.5 after costs, or fewer than 100 spikes in the test window.

questions.question: How much capital can it take?
questions.recommended: About 1 million USD per trade before the spread cost doubles.

known_shown: A dead end exists for funding-rate extremes on ETH perpetual futures, killed by costs in the 2023 retest.
